input.quote: 1.5 "FIELD OF USE" means, and is limited to, the utilization of the Licensed Technology by the Licensee for the exclusive purpose of fulfilling Spot FX transactions by transmitting market data and orders.
input.rationale: No provision restrains the businesses we may operate or the products we may buy or build, so the rule sits at the preferred position (no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer). The only "field of use" language (1.5, and the grant at p0030 "solely in the Field of Use", plus the use limits at p0033 and the Article II Additional Restrictions) limits how we may use Licensor's own Licensed Technology — a licence-scope term rather than a restraint on our FX business; the licence is expressly non-exclusive (p0043), and nothing prevents us from using, licensing, developing or acquiring alternative platforms or products. Article X contains only a non-solicitation of Licensor's employees (p0125), not a non-compete. The Change of Control consent/termination mechanic (p0134) and the Right of First Refusal (Article XXII) constrain a sale of our company rather than our operating business; those sit under the assignment/change-of-control rule and are not flagged twice here. Noted for information only, without redlining: the Field of Use excludes "any functions or applications not expressly described", so any future non-Spot FX use of the Platform would need a scope amendment.
